items.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: Rascher, Sigurd Rascher, and somebody named Nash.

ctx.x: Yeah. I had people that used to come to me to write things out for them before — what’s his name that put the book out?

Rascher, Sigurd Rascher, and somebody named Nash. I had a set of fingerings that worked for me when I was in high school with all of that. I just worked them out. I just had a system, I just was hearing high. And I went on. Then when I got to college they wouldn’t let me play saxophone ‘cause it wasn’t a classical instrument, you had to play clarinet. And that broke my heart. And you know what I had to do in order to stop playing it? I took all the pads out of my saxophone. I still got that. I took all the pads…
